summary.text: Dan Quick is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 35, serving since 2024 (he was also elected in 2016). His committee assignments are General Affairs, Health and Human Services, and Urban Affairs.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Quick was born December 29, 1957, in Grand Island and graduated from Hordville High School in 1976.
His biography lists past work as president and business manager of IBEW Local 1597 and as a maintenance mechanic, welder and heavy equipment operator.
It lists service on the Central Community College Board of Governors from 2022 to 2025 and on the boards of Heartland United Way and the Nebraska Alliance for Child Advocacy Centers.
It lists him as married to Alice Turek since April 26, 1980, with three children.
